Comfort.Title: Comfort Cookie
Comfort.Description: This cookie remembers your preferences (theme, language) and some of the data you type into tools (for example yesterday's Watch list), so you don't have to re-enter everything on each visit. It also lets you stay logged in longer if you activated the 'Stay logged in' option. Nothing is sent to a third party, nothing is used for advertising tracking — without this cookie, the site remains usable, just without memory from one visit to the next.

EconomyMines.HelpTitle: How does the Mine Report work?
EconomyMines.HelpPurpose: Compute your province's weekly mine report: production, upkeep and miners' salary, ready to share on the forum.
EconomyMines.HelpOverview: Two ways to use this chest: a quick daily report to post on the forum (paste today's text, then click straight on "Format today's report", no calculation, no week to pick), or a priced weekly report (steps below).
EconomyMines.HelpStep1: Pick the week you want to process with the arrows at the top of the page — only days within that specific week will be taken into account, even if your pastes contain others.
EconomyMines.HelpStep2: In the game, open the "Mine management" tab and copy the whole page text, starting from "Maintenance costs increase..." through to the end of the page.
EconomyMines.HelpStep3: Paste that text into the Mines Commissioner's Log. You can paste the interface several times to complete the data for the selected week: each new paste fills in the data already known, without ever erasing anything.
EconomyMines.HelpStep4: Click "Generate weekly report": it computes the production value, upkeep and net (after salary) for the selected week.
EconomyMines.WeekIncompleteWarning: Incomplete week: {count}/7 days covered ({monday} to {sunday}). The report is still computed from the data available.
